product_risk_or_requirement: AI and personal-data classification must be approved for the exact workflow
current_state: Preliminary classification exists but no signed role and privacy analysis
product_requirement: Block pilot until legal and privacy reviewers map the workflow data vendors and markets to current obligations
acceptance_criteria: Given the frozen pilot scope and data flow When pilot readiness is reviewed Then signed AI classification and privacy memos plus the system inventory record are present
deadline_or_trigger: Before any real applicant enters the pilot
evidence_needed: Signed legal memo privacy assessment data-flow record and system inventory

product_risk_or_requirement: Subgroup performance and job relevance are not independently verified
current_state: Only proposed metrics and a draft job rubric currently exist
product_requirement: Validate job relevance and subgroup recall on a representative holdout set before release and after material change
acceptance_criteria: Given a versioned model data set and job rubric When independent validation runs Then subgroup recall gap is at most 5 percentage points and every scored feature maps to documented job requirements
deadline_or_trigger: Before pilot and after any model data or job-criteria change
evidence_needed: Versioned evaluation report subgroup tables job analysis and reviewer approval

product_risk_or_requirement: Human review accommodation appeal and rollback are not yet rehearsed
current_state: Workflow is designed but has no completed simulation
product_requirement: Provide meaningful review with evidence time authority accessible alternative appeal and emergency stop capability
acceptance_criteria: Given simulated adverse recommendations and accommodation requests When recruiters and appeal staff execute the workflow Then every case has reason code review record timely resolution and successful override or rollback evidence
deadline_or_trigger: At least seven days before pilot start
evidence_needed: Drill report sample audit logs accessibility test appeal record and rollback evidence

product_risk_or_requirement: Production monitoring requires a documented threshold response
current_state: Metrics are specified but alert routing and incident retention are incomplete
product_requirement: Create weekly pilot monitoring with named on-call ownership immutable evidence and threshold-triggered pause
acceptance_criteria: Given pilot monitoring data When any guardrail or KRI threshold is breached Then the release is paused alerts reach owners and affected applications are queued for manual review
evidence_needed: Monitoring dashboard alert test incident runbook and retention record
